title: User's top clipboard item can be pasted on the lock screen
line: Pressing Ctrl+V on the lock screen no longer pastes the clipboard into the password field.
explanation: KWin offered the screen locker's Wayland client the same clipboard globals as any other app, so when the greeter got keyboard focus it received the session's current clipboard and primary selection, and Ctrl+V (or a middle click) pasted them into the password field. The change uses KWin's existing per-client interface filter to hide wl_data_device_manager and zwp_primary_selection_device_manager_v1 from the screen locker's connection, so the greeter never sees any clipboard content.

commits.message:
wayland: don't give the lock screen access to the clipboard

The screen locker could bind the data device and primary selection
managers, so Ctrl+V or a middle click in the password field pasted the
session's clipboard. Hide both globals from the screen locker's client.

BUG: 503596
